description:
An exceptional and confidential leadership opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) in Baltimore County, MD. Join a premier health and rehabilitation center committed to providing outstanding patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. This role offers a chance to lead a dynamic team and make a significant impact on the facility's success and the well-being of its community.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall operational management of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and upholding the highest quality of care. This position requires a visionary leader who can drive performance, manage resources effectively, and cultivate a positive culture. We are seeking a professional with a proven track record in skilled nursing facility administration, ready to embrace a challenging yet rewarding role. Compensation for this vital leadership position is highly competitive, ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 per year.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Demonstrated leadership abilities and strong operational management skills
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.
